thread:
maya: Noticed a cluster p95 spike at 08:42 when many tenants fell back to host pages. Thinking about lightweight queuing instead of blocking migrations.

kai: Can you paste logs?

maya: snippet:
[08:42:11] evictor: tenant=ui-prod freed=4GB reason=oom
[08:42:11] allocator: fallback_hit=true resident=host
[08:42:12] request: model=r-2B step=gen token=0 latency_ms=940

zhen: 940ms suggests we're blocking on memcpy or queue saturation.

samir: Proposal: per-tenant token credit + tiny seq pin (N pages). If credit exhausted, queue up to 15ms then escalate to migrate.

kai: Implementation: async host-stream fast-path + per-seq LRU pinned window. Need metrics: credit_used, queue_ms, escalations.

maya: Security: host buffers must be zeroed and bound to tenant keys. Add scrub-on-free.

infra-bot: feature flag rollout scheduled: routing.host-queue-canary -> 2026-06-01T01:00Z :rocket:

maya: Action items:
- kai: spike async stream + pin LRU (P0)
- zhen: add metrics + alerts (P1)
- samir: security checklist (P1)

kai: starting a quick spike, will post microbench numbers here.

maya: Keep customer API minimal (low_latency | cost_sensitive). We'll map to credits/pin internally.

zhen: Agreed. Trace attributes: fallback_mode, queue_ms, escalated=true/false.
